goal: Drive the May-agent platform through one canonical Agent App: keep event-driven task reconciliation, persistence, Runtime capabilities, SDK, shared UI, and App conventions coherent, tested, and reusable.
strategy: Keep platform design and principles in this app's docs/ tree.
Resolve every addressed input to one durable task; use events as persisted new information that creates or wakes work, and never edit host-private task persistence directly.
Use ../may-agent as the portable domain/runtime code workspace.
Route human steering through typed App input and translate facts into explicit task input, exact task or Condition wakes, or observation-only records.
Before claiming platform health, inspect bounded App/task projections, open alerts, recent failures, stale project state, evaluator findings, and communication failures.
Keep runtime scratch in .state/ and fold durable decisions back into docs, tasks, or code.
